### 6. Problem tree (visible materials only)
- Root: kept-vehicle cancellation refund/acceptance (customer's own write, owner=user).
- Hop R→W (state-derived): kept desk sentence "The refund on such a cancellation is fixed only after the contract's latest component repair line denied for the waiting period … has been re-decided and whatever that re-decision owes the holder has been paid, wherever …". Ledger shows CLM-4471208 denied `waiting_period` 09-09; every condition holds from records (deal sale, AC not lubricated + covered at Exclusionary, 09-08/41590 in term, diag fee only on A with customer-pay labor on A and no comeback credit, A labor closed 09-13 ≥ 09-09). The state "re-decided and paid" is brought about by the doc "Re-decision of Waiting-Period Denials" ("The contract pays the holder back once, as one paid component-repair line … same claim number, repair order and component group"), found by the words "denied for the waiting period" / "re-decided" used by both.
- Hop R→L (state-derived): kept desk sentence "The refund on such a cancellation is not computed until the rental benefit of the claim of the contract's latest component-repair line, paid or denied … has been settled and whatever rental it owes the holder has been paid, wherever the first loaner agreement … is a Kessler loaner on which the holder was charged daily rental and the coverage level's rental amount per day and rental day limit are both above zero." LA-448312 is the only agreement on RO 446215, holder charged `daily_rental` 135.00; Exclusionary 50.00/7 days. Found "Settling the Rental Benefit of a Claim" by "rental benefit of the claim".
- Hop L→W (state-derived): rental doc "A rental line is booked only after the records carry a paid component-repair line under the same claim number." Claim CLM-4471208 carries no paid line until the waiting re-decision books one.
- Order: W (re-decision) → L (rental) → R (acceptance). No hop pre-solved: no doc names another problem's tool or a route.
- Counter-proof "do only the cancellation": both kept-desk sentences are unmet at the opening (denied line unpaid; rental unsettled), so accepting the cancellation first leaves the refund in a state the desk says is not yet fixed/computed; it also changes the fee tier (25.00). Counter-proof "settle rental first": the rental doc's ordering sentence blocks the line while no paid component-repair line exists, and the "settled with nothing owed" branch would leave the 45.00 the claim owes once paid unpaid.
- Closest alternatives excluded: maintenance/coverage re-decisions (no such denials in the ledger); flat free-look (day 61 > 60); `flat_deal_unwound` (deal closed); RO 446215 deductible at selling store (disappearing deductible).
